book.name: Rom
book.title: Rau To Paulus Imbooda Ila To Yes Roma Rom—Romans

content: Tapul tauud tanim Maaron le

Tovenen yam toŋvetaz, aghita. Maaron lolo isamin ghiit ve igham mulin ghiit wa. Tauto naghaze napariaaŋ gham pa aghur anoŋamim ila pa Maaron inim watooŋrau mata yaryaara. Watooŋrau tovene, nene patabuaŋ ila ye mata, ve ighami lolo poia kat. Ighaze tambees pa Maaron itaghon ataam tovene, nene deŋia. Yo 4:24; Ro 6:13; 1Pe 2:5

Yes to titaghon ŋgar to taan, yam ala toman di pa ŋgar todi muul malep. Apul Maaron itoor ŋgar tiam ve gabuamim inim paghu kat. Leso aghilaal ŋgar to Maaron lolo pani. Nene ŋgar to poia kat, ve deŋia moghon, ve ighami lolo poia. Ep 4:23, 5:17; 1Yo 2:15+
Taŋgabiiz poian tauud, ve iit eŋaeŋa tagham uraat to Maaron ighuri inim nimaad

Maaron ighur ghou nanim uraata toni itaghon tau lolo ve poia toni. Tovenen you naghaze napariaaŋ gham asob tovene: Agham ŋgar sorok aghaze yam popoiamim alib pa nditamim malep. Yam irau aŋgabiiz poian taumim: Maaron igham gham aghur ila ariaŋa ve ataghon katin ghurla tiam ŋgara, ma maau? 2Kor 13:5; Pil 2:3
Iit anoŋaad le babaŋa naol: Agheed, nimaad, avood, mataad, ve mbeb pida paam. Ve anoŋaad to naol ne, ledi uraat eŋaeŋa irau di.
Iit to taneep tuŋia ila to Krisi, tovene paam. Iit tanimale Krisi nima, aghe, ve anoŋa babaŋa pida paam to tilup di tinim ee moghon. 1Kor 12:12-27

Maaron irei uraat ve tapiri naol naol le irau ghiit, itaghon tau lolo ve poia toni. Tovenen iit irau tagham uraat toit toit. Ighaze Maaron ighur ŋgeu eta inim propet, ŋgeu tonenen irau ivotia Maaron aliŋa pa tamtoghon itaghon ghurla toni.
Ighaze Maaron igham ŋgeu eta le ŋgar pa uraat to ulaaŋ tamtoghon, ye irau itaghon katin ŋgar to ulaaŋ. Ve ighaze tamtoghon eta le uraat pa ipatoot tamtoghon pa Maaron aliŋa, ye irau ipatoot di kat.

Ve ighaze eta le ŋgar pa uraat to palotiiŋ tamtoghon, ye irau ipalot di. Ve ighaze eta le uraat pa reiŋ mbeb pa yes mbolaaŋa, ye irau iuul di kat, ve irei mbeb toni toman lolo poia. Ighaze eta le ŋgar pa ŋginiiŋ uraat, ye irau mata iza pa uraat toni, ve igham katini. Ve ighaze eta le ŋgar pa uraat to ulaaŋ yes to pataŋani igham di, ye irau iuul di toman lolo poia. 2Kor 9:6-13; 1Pe 5:2
Tutuuŋ pida to tiŋarua tamtoghon to Krisi

Ighaze yam aghur lolomim pa tamtoghon, agham kaarom pani malep. Aghur lolomim padi kat, ve apatooŋ anoŋa ivot. Yam irau aghur koi pa ŋgar samia ve aneep saguan pani. Ve ŋgar poia, ghoro akisi tuŋia. 2Kor 6:6; 1Tes 5:21+; 1Pe 1:22
Yam anim toŋvetaz to Krisi wa. Tovenen lolomim pa taumim kat ve agham poian gham. Agham ŋgar pa taumim izamim malep. Apait nditamim pa ŋgar popoia to yes tigham di. Ga 5:26; Pil 2:3; Hib 13:1
Uraat to agham pa Ŋgeu Tiina, matamim mormoria pani malep. Apul Avuvu Patabuaŋ ipamundigin gham, leso matamim kaviaaŋa pa mbesooŋ tiam, ve aghami toman lolomim. 1Tes 5:19

Yam awatag: Muri, Maaron pale igham mulin ghiit ve taneep pooi. Matamim iŋgal mbeb tonene ve aghur matamim pani irau sawa isob. Leso igham gham lolomim poia. Ve ayoon ariaŋa pa badooŋ pataŋani, ve asuŋ irau sawa isob. Apul suŋuuŋ malep. Ro 5:2, 15:13; Kol 4:2; 1Tes 5:16+; Yems 1:4
Ighaze mbolaaŋ igham Maaron tamtoghon toni, ghoro auul di. Ve ighaze loomba tilat, yam agham di toman lolomim poia, ve aŋgin poian di. 2Kor 8:7; Hib 13:2; 1Pe 4:9
Ighaze tamtoghon tighur pataŋani payam pasa, ataghon ŋgar to Krisi, yam aghur samia iza todi malep. Aghason Maaron pa igham poian di. Mt 5:44+; 1Kor 4:12; 1Pe 3:9
Yes to tinidi iza, yam tinimim iza toman di. Ve yes to ledi pataŋani ve titaŋ, yam ataŋ toman di.
Yam asob alup lolomim ve ŋgar tiam inim ee moghon. Apait taumim, ve ala toman yes to izadi tintina moghon malep. Yam irau alup gham toman yes to ledi izadi maau. Ve aparim taumim pa ŋgar tiam malep.
Ighaze tamtoghon tigham samin gham, ayati pa ŋgar samia malep. Atoova pa ataghon ŋgar to deŋia moghon ila tamtoghon tisob matadi. Mt 5:39; 2Kor 8:21; 1Tes 5:15
Ve atoova pa alup gham toman tamtoghon tisob anim ee moghon. Tovenen sa ŋgar to yam irau aghami pa ilup gham, ghoro aghami. Mt 5:9; Ro 14:19; Hib 12:14

Yam ndiran tiou, lolog payam kat. Nayol aliŋag muul. Ŋgar samia to tamtoghon tigham payam, yam ayati malep. Apuli ila Maaron nima. Ye tau pale ighur pataŋani iŋarua di. Pasa, Maaron aliŋa to timbooda, isaav ighaze:

content.text: “You leg uraat pa naghur atia pa ŋgar samia. Taug pale nayati.” Lo 32:35; Mbo 94:1; Hib 10:30

content: Tovenen taumim ayat ŋgar samia malep. Agham poian koiamimŋa. Pasa, Maaron aliŋa waaro ite isaav tovene:

content.text: “Ighaze koiam eta pitoola, ugham a aniiŋ.
Ve ighaze muruni, ugham a ya.
Leso ughami ighilaala sosor toni, ve maya.” Igham 23:4+; Np 25:21+; Mt 5:44

content: Tovenen apul ŋgar samia itatan gham malep. Yam irau atatan ŋgar samia pa ŋgar poia.

footnotes.text: Ataam ite to tatoor saveeŋ waaro tonene, nene vene: “ŋgeu tonenen irau ivotia Maaron aliŋa pa tamtoghon itaghon saveeŋ to iit taghur ila.”
Ataam ite to tatoor saveeŋ waaro tonene, nene vene: “Azuaria gham pa uraat tintina pa agham izamim pani malep. Uraat tau tamtoghon tighita inimale uraat sorok, yam irau aghami toman lolomim poia.”
